steps: Define decision variables X, Y as integer LpVariables with non-negative bounds
Extract optimal solution and total cost

method.name: Integer Linear Programming with OR-Tools CP-SAT
steps: Define integer variables X, Y with non-negative bounds using CpModel
Solve with CpSolver and OPTIMAL status
Extract optimal solution and objective value

rationale: Alternative CP-SAT solver from OR-Tools, which is more modern and often faster for certain problem types. Different solver backend provides diversity in case PuLP+CBC has issues.
